title: What Time Banking Federations 2.0 Is
definition: Time Banking Federations 2.0: next-gen federated hour-for-hour exchange.
description:
Time Banking Federations 2.0 is next-gen federated hour-for-hour exchange. It sits squarely in Post-Scarcity Economy, the frontier where time ledgers science becomes federation logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are hour valuation-scale. Societies that master federation hulls early will shape skill matching practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why time ledgers programs worldwide now treat Time Banking Federations 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Time Banking Federations 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Real Research Today: Time Banking Federations 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Time Banking Federations 2.0.
description:
The road to Time Banking Federations 2.0 is already being paved. Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale. The Venus Project and resource-based economy literature model post-money logistics.

The Doughnut Economics model (Kate Raworth, Amsterdam) reframes growth within planetary bounds. Together these programs form the time ledgers foundation that Time Banking Federations 2.0 will build on — the federation logistics results, the skill matching methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as federation logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Time Banking Federations 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Time Banking Federations 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Time Banking Federations 2.0 — next-gen federated hour-for-hour exchange.

Phase 1 — Prove (time ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (federation logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (skill matching): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (hour valuation): federation hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and communities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
